ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing ail of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 26-F in
the area bound by:

the alley next west of and parallel to South Princeton Avenue; the alley next north of and
parallel to West 111th Street; a line 175 feet west of and parallel to South Princeton
Avenue; and West 111" Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

VY ada

RonntaL. Mosley
Alderman, 21% Ward

318-344 W. 111" Street
